title: Executive Briefing Book: Engineering Leadership & Technical Operations Transition

content.executive_summary: This Executive Briefing Book compiles all verified institutional knowledge for the Engineering Leadership & Technical Operations transition. Across 32 ratified claims, 15 indexed entities, and 11 relational dependencies, this dossier provides complete traceability back to 10 deposited primary records. Key operational initiatives include Project Odyssey (GA Feb 28, 2027), Project Aegis (Beta Feb 1, 2027), and Project Nova (Security Testing Dec 20, 2026), alongside 3 ratified resolutions and 6 open discrepancies awaiting human adjudication.
content.mandate_overview: The outgoing authority (Marcus Vance) relinquishes administrative oversight, signatory powers, and technical directorship to the incoming successor (Aman Kumar). Key governance domains encompass 5 core institutional decisions, 12 active responsibilities, and oversight of 4 active project streams.
